items.title: Russia's Sber eyes USDT loans, questions digital ruble demand
items.summary: Russia’s largest bank, Sber, plans to accept USDT and Ether alongside Bitcoin as loan collateral as the country introduces regulated crypto trading under a new law.

items.title: Real Trump Coins denies launching GOLD token, blames ‘bad actors'
items.summary: Trump-linked Real Trump Coins said it never authorized GOLD or any digital token as questions persisted over its X account, associated domains and the concentrated token supply.
